mechanism.claim: At the fixed UTC day boundary, unusually volatile BTC price discovery accompanied by a large same-direction normalized aggressive taker flow in the dominant Binance BTC/USDT book identifies one-sided flow saturation. The crowded completed-day price direction should reverse for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: opposite sign of the completed BTC 24-hour return
mechanism.why_distinct: DAFSR requires same-direction daily price and dominant-book taker-flow saturation, then trades inventory exhaustion. DSQFCR required USDT+USDC consensus and followed flow; CVBRPCR selected price momentum with a crypto-options beta residual; RV20 used liquidation and OI fields.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed-day realized variation must be in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one 00:05 UTC daily flow-saturation entry is absent from Gross9

features.source_day: exact prior UTC day [D-24h,D), requiring 24 source-complete BTCUSDT hourly flow rows and 24 consecutive completed BTC price hours
features.price_return: log(last completed-hour close/first completed-hour open), nonzero
features.saturation: flow and price return have the same nonzero sign
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum of 24 squared completed-hour BTC log returns)
features.volatility_rank: strict-prior midrank against at most 90 valid days, minimum 60; current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.decision: exact D 00:00 UTC after every source feature is available
clock.reservation: fixed daily decisions; global half-open, exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_implied_vol: not signal inputs; exact funding only for later PnL

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.flow: hash-bound Binance stablecoin quote-flow panel through 2026-07-31
source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent daily dominant-book flow-saturation reversal mechanism

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no threshold, side, hold, clock, or subset repair.
